name: ph-sss-philhealth
description: Philippine SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG contributions for self-employed people in 2026. Classifies active self-employment, voluntary continuation, employees, overseas workers and other earning groups before calculating contributions. Includes the SSS salary-credit brackets, mandatory provident allocation and Employees’ Compensation; PhilHealth income floor, ceiling, 2026 annual settlement and missed-premium rules; and Pag-IBIG’s different member and employer shares. Use to prepare a monthly budget, reconcile payment records, register with the correct fund, generate payment references or address a gap. Covers concurrent employment, domestic workers, older members and the distinction between compulsory contributions and optional savings. Benefit awards, loan approval, MP2 pre-termination and income-tax deductions require their separate eligibility and evidence checks.
